help.label: How to make: {{name}}
help.templateAlt: Template for {{name}}: the framed area is the safe zone
desktopBanner: The template is the full picture. Put faces, the logo and text inside the framed middle zone.
iPad (landscape) shows exactly the middle zone. Wider screens show more of the sides, so keep the sides as scenery only.
On a portrait screen the banner gets shorter, but the middle zone is never cut.
phoneBanner: The template is the full picture. Put faces, the logo and text inside the framed middle zone.
Phones show the whole picture, so the edges are seen too.
railImage: The logo fills its block in the left menu, edge to edge, with the kitchen name below it.
Keep the logo inside the framed centre; the edges may be trimmed a little.
railIcon: iPhone rounds the corners itself, so draw the picture square, full-bleed.
Android may cut it into a circle, so keep the mark inside the middle 80%.
The closed left menu shows it at 72 × 72.
bannerBackgroundImage: Shown behind the banner on very wide screens.
Use scenery or a pattern only, with no text or faces.
